annotations.title: Check Smart OCR Quota & API Credits

description: Check Smart OCR server health, remaining anonymous daily free-tier document quota (2 free documents/day per IP), and optionally validate an `api_key` to inspect remaining paid page credits. Read-only and consumes zero credits. Use before running extractions to verify quota or credit availability; do NOT use to poll async extraction jobs (`get_document_job`).

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`) to validate and inspect remaining page credits; falls back to `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` header.

name: get_smartocr_status

apiKeyStatus.description: Validated API key details (`valid`, `email`, `creditsRemaining`, `apiKeyHint`) or anonymous tier notice string.

apiKeyHint.description: Last 4 characters of the API key.

email.description: Account email associated with the API key.

message.description: Validation error message when `valid` is false.

valid.description: Whether the supplied API key is active.

freeTierDailyQuota.description: Anonymous IP-based free daily extraction allowance.

maxFreePerDay.description: Maximum free anonymous documents per UTC day (2).

links.description: Canonical Smart OCR documentation, web app, and MCP URLs.
